agents.title: Chief Protocol & Interoperability Architect
agents.scope: Coordinates bounded protocol audits, selects relevant specialists and reconciles evidence.

agents.title: MCP Specification & Snapshot Auditor
agents.scope: Reviews MCP feature claims, version-specific required fields, tooling capabilities and structural errors.

agents.title: A2A Agent-Card & Protocol Analyst
agents.scope: Checks A2A v1 agent-card shapes, declared skills, interfaces and negotiation assumptions.

agents.title: Schema & Contract Quality Engineer
agents.scope: Audits tool input/output schema contract shape and breaking-change evidence.

agents.title: Tool Catalog & Capability Engineer
agents.scope: Inspects tools/list metadata, descriptions, annotations and discoverability.

agents.title: Transport Diagnostics Engineer
agents.scope: Investigates stdio, Streamable HTTP, timeouts, SSE and protocol negotiation behavior.

agents.title: Authentication & Token Boundary Reviewer
agents.scope: Assesses OAuth, bearer tokens, session isolation, token storage and authorization separation.

agents.title: Least-Privilege & Authorization Tester
agents.scope: Checks permission models, denied tools, approval gates, blocked operations and escalation.

agents.title: Deterministic Replay Evaluation Engineer
agents.scope: Replays imported JSON-RPC fixture records and checks expectations without live execution.

agents.title: Controlled Fixture Designer
agents.scope: Builds minimal safe MCP/A2A mock scenarios, positive and negative cases.

agents.title: Tool-Call Trace & Failure Analyst
agents.scope: Examines recorded message sequence, errors, state transitions and unexpected success.

agents.title: Protocol Compatibility & Version Engineer
agents.scope: Tracks MCP/A2A protocol revisions, extension profiles and negotiation gaps.

agents.title: Cross-IDE Compatibility Curator
agents.scope: Summarizes host-specific test outcomes without overclaiming support.

agents.title: Multi-Agent Benchmark Engineer
agents.scope: Designs controlled cross-framework agent tasks and test harness methodology.

agents.title: Protocol & Integration Regression Engineer
agents.scope: Compares recorded contract snapshots and tool behavior between releases.

agents.title: Evidence Integrity & Reproducibility Auditor
agents.scope: Tracks source hashes, test provenance, restrictions and reproducibility capsules.

agents.title: Protocol Security & Prompt Injection Auditor
agents.scope: Reviews SSRF, DNS rebinding, tool-result injection, credential exposure and unsafe MCP servers.

agents.title: Compatibility Release Readiness Engineer
agents.scope: Determines readiness according to executed criteria, regression evidence and explicit release policy.
